|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">帝国軍は高感度な器材を使用して、捕えた宇宙船の閉ざされた区画を探査する。探査部隊ＢＴ－445はミレニアム・ファルコン号を調べようとした。</span><ref name="jp1-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Scanning Crew.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to look at the opponent's hand for 10 seconds. If you find Rebel cards, you may choose one of them and move it to the top of the opponent's Used Deck.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Lore:''' The Imperial forces use highly sensitive equipment to scan closed compartments of captured starships. Scanning crew BT-445 tried to inspect the Millennium Falcon.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the destination the Used Deck, while the English calls it the Used Pile. The Japanese lore describes closed compartments rather than shielded compartments, and says that BT-445 tried to inspect the ship rather than planned to search it.<ref name="jp1-face" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-D-scanningcrew.gif|Scanning Crew original English printed face]].</ref>
|notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Scanning Crew]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105.
